summary: 合同变更后续只读片 on BASE 71d5665. Added contracts.approval_services.contract_change_impact(member, change_id) and contract_change_impact_list(member, *, contract_id=None): a read-only projection over the existing Contract/ContractVersion/ContractChange/Settlement/OpenItem/Clearance/RevenueRecognition facts, returning the change ref/type/status/requested date/version, contract ref/status/termination marker, the approved version before the change (the version with version_no-1 for an effective price/other change; the still-approved version for a termination) and the new approved version after it (None for termination), affected contract-line refs (before and after lines unioned), active Settlement count/gross, active OpenItem count/gross, active Clearance count/cleared amount, posted RevenueRecognition count/net amount, and the change deltas. The service is append-only read behaviour: no audit, receipt, event or fact write; permissions are owner/finance/auditor, PM only for managed projects with summary_only=true, member denied, cross-company/unknown change denied. Termination depth: the existing PH-265 guards (change draft requires an active contract; approved_terms_snapshot rejects as_of >= terminated_on) were kept without duplicating settlement write code, and the read snapshots now expose terminated/terminated_on/contract_status markers so downstream pairing is never silent; regressions assert new change and settlement attempts after termination are refused with zero half-writes. Browser: contract detail gained a read-only 变更影响（只读） section (before/after versions, affected lines, settlement/open-item/clearance/revenue counts and amounts, termination badge, link to per-change impact) and a new read-only change_detail.html page; a history_read route contract-change-impact keeps the historical impact readable after the contracts module is disabled, with no new write entry. No model/migration/canonical topic/command/schema change and no revenue/ledger/cash/open-item write. Reviewer round-1 blocker fixed: effective_on is no longer aliased to the request date; it is derived from the recorded fact (a termination uses contract.terminated_on, an approved non-termination change uses the new ContractVersion.effective_on) and is null for drafts/rejected/withdrawn, with regressions where requested_on differs from the new version effective_on and where effective_on == terminated_on. Scoped PH-275 tests are now 10 OK; full suite 976 tests/116.491s with only the known 8 macOS baseline failures.

review.reviewer: independent PH-275 contract-change-impact reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - `effective_on` is not the business effective date: `_impact_payload` sets `'effective_on': change.requested_on.isoformat()` for every change type. `ContractChange` only has `requested_on`; the business effective date is `after.effective_on` for an approved non-termination change (the new ContractVersion's effective_on) and `contract.terminated_on` for a termination. The new commit 0a585a0 therefore exposes a field labelled effective_on that is actually the request date for price changes and terminations, violating the spec's frozen '变更 ref/类型/生效时间' and the worker's stated fix. No test asserts effective_on, so the green scoped run does not catch it. Fix: derive effective_on from the already-computed `after`/`before` refs and the contract termination marker (termination -> contract.terminated_on; approved non-termination with after version -> after.effective_on; otherwise None or explicitly documented draft semantics), and add a regression where the new version effective_on differs from requested_on plus a termination assertion `effective_on == terminated_on`.

READ-ONLY PURITY/TERMINATION/PERMISSIONS (otherwise verified): `contract_change_impact`/`_list` only read Contract/ContractVersion/ContractChange/Settlement/OpenItem/Clearance/RevenueRecognition; no audit/receipt/DomainEvent/business-fact writes, no company lock, no settlement write; the service and list are read-only projections, and the HTTP route is history_read so the impact page survives contracts module disablement (tests assert audit/event counts unchanged). Active-only settlement/open-item/clearance and posted-only revenue aggregations are used; before version is version_no-1 (or latest approved for draft/termination), after version is only the approved change version, termination has no after version and shows terminated/terminated_on; termination tests assert new change and new settlement are rejected with zero half-writes via the existing approved_terms_snapshot guard (no settlement file change, acceptable per spec's 'if PH-265 already covers, only tests/error wording'). PM gets summary_only=true and project scoping; member/cross-tenant/unknown are denied; owner/finance/auditor read. No model/migration/contract schema/canonical topic change; makemigrations clean; 14 changed files all inside PH-275 allowed_paths; task in_review, manifest=PH-275.
